live_activation_gate_determination.reasoning: The formal opintel_activation.domain.GovernanceReviewRecord schema requires state/evidence_refs/accountable_role, not a named personal signature field. This project's own 2026-08-21 A-17 precedent record was treated as actionable APPROVE_WITH_CONTROLS evidence with reviewer_subject_ref left null, identity reconciliation explicitly deferred rather than blocking. With APPROVE_WITH_CONTROLS plus PROJECT_OWNER's now-supplied counsel_pilot_approval, A-17 is treated as satisfying the live-activation gate for this bounded pilot under the existing schema. reviewer_identity_binding_state remains open and disclosed, not silently resolved.

required_controls.detail: Federal CAN-SPAM Act compliance for the message as a whole.
A real, identified sender: Andrew, Proofline.
Proofline, Str. Lucian Blaga, nr. 8, Ciugud, Alba 517240, Romania, disclosed in the message.
Conspicuous reply-UNSUBSCRIBE instruction, no fee, no login, no extra personal information required.
No tracking parameters, pixels, or redirects anywhere in the message or any linked URL.
Subject/header/body must not misrepresent sender or content; DO_NOT_PREPEND_ADV honored (no ADV: prefix added).
The message and any linked demo must not imply Proofline is affiliated with or operating on behalf of A-Plus.
No personal/consumer contact data; B2B professional context only, per ADR-0043.
Exact source URL + content sha256 retained for every quoted public fact.
opintel_suppression.enforce_pre_send_suppression_gate, no override path, re-checked at send time regardless of prior approval.
The exact sent message, headers, and recipient must be logged for the single authorized send.

counsel_operational_instruction.note: Recorded as a counsel-directed operational instruction for this exact Texas pilot, not an internally derived legal conclusion. No general subject-line policy is asserted beyond this pilot's scope.
